name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-06-20, at wavelengths from 1.65 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
